quality.reason: Well-structured report with deduplication, engagement metrics, scores, and source links, but the surfaced signals are low-engagement promotional tweets with hype language rather than clearly actionable alpha.

Well-structured operational dashboard with concrete metrics and relevant news, but duplicate ETH signals from the same scanner, malformed/empty token tags, and truncated news text reduce its actionable value.

Well-structured review with genuinely actionable signals: BTC's active strategy flagged as losing to its runner-up, SOL's active strategy missing from top-10 rankings, and score trend deltas over time — the flag column surfaces decisions rather than just dumping data.

Well-structured table with useful context (funding divergence on HYPE, whale profit-taking on a +101% long), but the headline $50K BTC buy is far below genuine whale size, diluting the alert's signal value.

Well-structured review with concrete metrics, deltas, and clearly flagged failures (scanner volume collapse, 0% uptime endpoints, 130-day-broken meta-agent) that give direct investigation targets, though it lacks explicit prioritization or recommended remediation steps.

Well-structured scan with clear methodology disclosure (including transparent fallback from rate-limited arXiv API to web search), relevant paper selection for the stated domains, and proper formatting with citations, though the truncated view limits verification of full paper summaries and accuracy.

Well-structured with good analytical discipline (flagging mechanical expiry repricing vs. real sentiment shifts), but the headline Fed move is below its own 10pp threshold and most of the payload is self-acknowledged mechanical noise, limiting true actionability.
